```{r setup, include=FALSE}
library(flexdashboard)
library(tidyverse) 
library(knitr)
library(ggplot2)
```

```{r}
BLM <- read_csv("blm_colorado_3.csv")

BLM <- BLM %>%
  rename(Address1 = `Address_1`,
         Address2 = `Address_2`,
         ZipCode = `Zip_Code`,
         PhoneNumber = `Phone_Number`,
         PICKNICKING = `PICNICkING`,
         DescriptionCharacterLength = `Description_Length`,
         DescriptionLengthWords = `Description_Length_Words`,
         DirectionCharacterLength = `Direction_Length`,
         DirectionLengthWords = `Direction_Length_Words`)

print(BLM)
BLM
```
